description: Pins a repository to binge-ci's release tags: the `uses:` digest pins and the `binge-ci` submodule, in one pull request labelled `agent`.

packageRules.description: The binge-ci actions and workflows, pinned by digest with the release tag in the trailing comment. Only v1.0.N tags are ever a target, never the moving `v1`.
The binge-ci submodule, in the same pull request. It follows the branch its .gitmodules names, which must be `stable`: that branch only ever moves to a tagged release commit.
